paper.title_en: PyLOCO: A Python Framework for Linear Optics Correction in Storage Rings
paper.abstract_en: We present a newly developed Python-based tool implementing the Linear Optics from Closed Orbits (LOCO) method. The tool provides a fast and flexible framework for lattice-parameter fitting and linear-optics correction in storage rings. Experimental validation at PETRA III and ESRF-EBS demonstrates its robustness and accuracy for optics correction in machine operation, as well as its use as a diagnostic tool for quadrupole error reconstruction.
